project.name: my-slint-kit (slintcn)
project.description: A premium UI components library merging Shadcn web design principles with LVGL embedded HMI concepts, built entirely in Rust and Slint.

development_constraints.constraint: All components in ui/components/ must inherit from Rectangle, Flickable, or other layout primitives. None should inherit from Window, to ensure they can be nested.
Do not hardcode styles. All colors, spacing, and animations must bind directly to the Theme global declared in tokens.slint.

To avoid cyclic imports, components must import only tokens.slint or icons.slint. Example screens in ui/examples/ must import components directly from their source files (e.g., import { Button } from "../components/button.slint";) and not from an umbrella module.

Do not compute complex layout dimensions inside state transitions. Instead, use inline conditional expressions directly on property declarations (e.g. width: checked ? 100px : 50px;) and animate the property.
When creating UI demos or test layouts, never use placeholders. Build full, production-ready widgets and actual graphics.
